claims.claim: A hot July evening; a young man leaves his garret in S. Place and walks toward K. bridge
claims.evidence: first sentence; 'exceptionally hot evening early in July'
'examination of the Petersburg school of Engineering'; 'Petersburg stench'

claims.claim: He slips out past his landlady, hopelessly in debt to her
claims.evidence: 'He had successfully avoided meeting his landlady'; 'hopelessly in debt to his landlady'

claims.claim: Overstrained and cut off from other people
claims.evidence: 'overstrained irritable condition... isolated from his fellows'
'A student then, or formerly a student'; 'crushed by poverty'

claims.claim: He murders an old pawnbroker and her sister
claims.evidence: 'the old pawnbroker, Alyona Ivanovna'; Lizaveta 'the old woman's sister'

claims.claim: The murder is with an axe
claims.evidence: 'examining the axe'; 'I shall strike her on the head'

claims.claim: Fevered and guilt-ridden, he is drawn to the Marmeladov family, especially his daughter Sonia
claims.evidence: Marmeladov in the tavern; Sonia 'Marmeladov's daughter'

claims.claim: His friend Razumihin and sister Dounia care for him
The magistrate Porfiry Petrovitch suspects him
claims.evidence: text: 'Porfiry Petrovitch, the head of the Investigation Department'; 'magistrate' not used
claims.fix: The head of the Investigation Department, Porfiry Petrovitch, suspects him

claims.claim: Svidrigaïlov pursues Dounia, learns the secret

claims.evidence: 'You want me to go to Siberia'

claims.claim: Gets eight years' penal servitude in Siberia
claims.evidence: 'penal servitude in the second class for a term of eight years only'

claims.claim: Sonia follows him and he begins to be renewed
claims.evidence: 'Sonia and he at last set off'; 'full resurrection into a new life. They were renewed'

claims.claim: Pulcheria and Dounia come to St. Petersburg
Dounia's fiance Luzhin is exposed as a schemer
claims.evidence: Luzhin accuses Sonia of stealing; Lebeziatnikov: 'What vileness!'

claims.claim: Characters: Sonia devout; Porfiry examining magistrate; Pulcheria mother; Dounia sister; Svidrigaïlov dissolute landowner
claims.evidence: Porfiry is 'head of the Investigation Department'; Svidrigaïlov described as the landowner in whose house Dounia was insulted; 'devout' not established
claims.fix: Porfiry: head of the Investigation Department; Sonia: Marmeladov's daughter, who goes with him to Siberia
